sites.doi_note: SanctSound issues per-site, per-detection-type DOIs at NCEI (e.g. 10.25921/PF0H-SQ72) rather than one collection-level DOI — confirmed live this session against the NCEI passive-acoustic-data page. No single DOI exists for the project as a whole, so doi is recorded null and the project landing page is used as the canonical url. Underlying archive filenames (NOAA-Navy-SanctSound_*) show the U.S. Navy as a co-contributing data partner alongside NOAA ONMS.
